The Prophet ordered people only deeds within their strength, and grew angry when they said they were unlike him, saying he feared and knew Allah best of all.
Religion is easy and whoever overburdens himself cannot keep it up, so avoid extremes, aim near perfection and draw strength from worship morning, afternoon and late night.
Told of a woman's excessive praying, the Prophet said to do deeds within one's capacity, for Allah does not tire, and the best deed is the one done regularly.
The Prophet told those sent to Yemen to make things easy and not repel people, chose the easier way unless sinful, and said they were sent to make things easy.
